description: Use this when someone asks what size of air conditioner, mini split or heater a room needs, in BTU, tons or watts. Calculates the capacity for one room from its floor area. roomAirConditioner: ENERGY STAR's sizing table for room air conditioners (8 ft ceiling): 100 up to 150 sq ft 5,000 BTU/h, 150 up to 250 6,000, 250 up to 300 7,000, 300 up to 350 8,000, 350 up to 400 9,000, 400 up to 450 10,000, 450 up to 550 12,000, 550 up to 700 14,000, 700 up to 1,000 18,000, 1,000 up to 1,200 21,000, 1,200 up to 1,400 23,000, 1,400 up to 1,500 24,000, 1,500 up to 2,000 30,000, 2,000 up to 2,500 34,000; a room under 100 sq ft takes 5,000 and `below` is true; then −10 % heavily shaded, +10 % very sunny, +600 BTU/h for each person beyond two, +4,000 BTU/h in a kitchen. miniSplit: area in sq ft × 25 BTU/h (Carrier, Trane), and the smallest size of Trane's chart that covers it: 6,000, 9,000, 12,000, 15,000, 18,000, 24,000, 30,000, 36,000, 48,000 or 60,000 BTU/h, up to 2,400 sq ft. heater: an electric room heater at 10 W per sq ft as supplemental heat, or 15 W as the sole heat or in a poorly insulated room (Broan-NuTone). It returns the area in square meters, the base and each adjustment, the capacity in BTU/h, tons (12,000 BTU/h) and kilowatts (1 ton = 3.516853 kW, NIST SP 811), and BTU/h per sq ft. None of these is a load calculation; a system for a whole house is sized with ACCA Manual J and Manual S (IRC M1401.3).

area.description: Floor area in square meters, used instead of length and width.

heat.description: Heater only: supplemental (10 W per sq ft) or sole, for the only heat of the room or a poorly insulated room (15 W per sq ft); supplemental when left out.

kitchen.description: Room air conditioner only: true adds 4,000 BTU/h for a kitchen.

people.description: Room air conditioner only: people who regularly use the room; 600 BTU/h for each beyond two. 2 when left out.

sun.description: Room air conditioner only: shaded takes 10 % off, sunny adds 10 %; average when left out.

system.description: roomAirConditioner: a window, portable or through-the-wall unit by ENERGY STAR's table; miniSplit: Carrier's and Trane's first estimate; heater: an electric room heater by Broan-NuTone's rule.
